nodes.label: Shopify AI Toolkit
nodes.rationale: Mandated for all Shopify API and platform work; installed in the agent host rather than the repo so that no tooling is added to the project.

nodes.label: @react-router/serve
nodes.rationale: react-router-serve never enables Express trust proxy, which is why origin comparison fails behind TLS-terminating proxies.

nodes.label: Shopify Dev MCP added to template
nodes.norm_label: shopify dev mcp added to template

nodes.label: afterAuth shop-specific webhook registration
nodes.rationale: afterAuth only runs after install and when an access token expires, so subscriptions are rarely updated during normal development.

nodes.label: Admin object undefined on CLI-triggered webhooks
nodes.norm_label: admin object undefined on cli-triggered webhooks
nodes.rationale: The CLI triggers events with a valid but non-existent shop, so admin is only present for shops that installed the app.

nodes.label: Shopify CLI
nodes.rationale: Powers local development: logs in, connects to an app, provides environment variables, updates remote config, creates a tunnel and generates extensions.

nodes.label: Shopify App Template - React Router README
nodes.norm_label: shopify app template - react router readme

nodes.label: qs forced to ^6.16.0
nodes.rationale: Clears two CVEs that reach the app transitively through @react-router/serve and express@4.

nodes.label: React Router family pinned to 7.18.2
nodes.rationale: 7.18.3 tightened action-origin validation to the full origin, making every action return 400 under shopify app dev and behind TLS-terminating proxies forwarding plain HTTP.

nodes.label: removeRest future flag
nodes.rationale: Enabled so new apps are not tempted to use the REST Admin API.

nodes.label: App-specific webhooks
nodes.rationale: Declared in shopify.app.toml because Shopify syncs them on every deploy, and they avoid both stale shop-specific subscriptions and HMAC failures from admin-created webhooks.

nodes.label: Embedded app navigation rules
nodes.rationale: Embedded apps must maintain the user session inside an iFrame, so use Link, the redirect returned from authenticate.admin, and useSubmit rather than a tags or react-router redirect.

nodes.label: Polaris web components 2.x (polaris-2.js)
nodes.rationale: Default in shopify-app-react-router v4, giving new apps the Admin Next look; apps can stay on Polaris 1.x through polarisUrl.

nodes.label: @shopify/polaris-types
nodes.rationale: Updated to v2 so the s-* component types match the Polaris version loaded at runtime. Renamed from @shopify/app-bridge-ui-types.

nodes.label: SQLite default database
nodes.rationale: Works in production only when the app runs as a single instance; otherwise switch datasource provider or SessionStorage adapter.

nodes.label: /auth/login route removal
nodes.rationale: The route relied on AppProvider embedded={false}, which v2 removed; the _index route login form now submits to its own action, which calls shopify.login() and shows shop-domain errors inline.

nodes.label: expiringOfflineAccessTokens flag
nodes.rationale: Adopted for enhanced security through token rotation.

nodes.label: Node.js 22.12+ requirement
nodes.rationale: shopify-app-react-router v2 dropped Node.js 20, so the Dockerfile moved to node:22-alpine.

nodes.label: openssl in Docker image for Prisma
nodes.norm_label: openssl in docker image for prisma

nodes.label: PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary fix
nodes.rationale: Runs the query engine as a separate process, which can work via emulation on Windows ARM64.
